Distinction internationale pour un proje: International distinction for an Algerian AI project
GENÈVE — Le projet « Intelligence artifi: GENEVA — The “Artificial Intelligence for Digital Inclusion” project, supported by Algérie Télécom, received an international award during the World Summit on the Information Society Forum (WSIS 2026). Out of 1,595 projects submitted by 122 countries, this initiative was selected in the information and communication infrastructure category.
Le certificat d'appréciation a été décer: The certificate of appreciation was awarded by the International Telecommunications Union (ITU) to highlight its role in promoting digital transformation and supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. The official handover took place in Geneva from July 6 to 10, 2026, in the presence of ITU Secretary General, Doreen Boukadan Martin.
L'initiative émane de Hashemi Ibrahim Ab: The initiative comes from Hashemi Ibrahim Abdelhak, owner of the project, and has been praised for its impact on digital inclusion and technological infrastructure. This prize also recognizes Algeria's efforts in the field of digital innovation.
